additional_context: ServiceRequest is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. Later FHIR-41664 generalized the terminology canonical from ServiceRequest-specific wording to the shared Request Order Detail Parameter Code value set; that later issue is already represented on the combined branch and explains the current request-orderdetail-parameter-code URL/name. Negative Zulip searches found no conflicting community discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current ServiceRequest source has the accepted definition, an example-strength binding named RequestOrderDetailParameterCode, and the current valueSet http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/request-orderdetail-parameter-code. The referenced value set and code system exist in the ServiceRequest source folder and include parenthetical-list example codes such as catheter-insertion, body-elevation, device-configuration, and device-settings.
